notes: New: Radio's customizable transport controls - Seek, Previous/Next, or Both, with a 5-55 second seek duration - now work the same way across TV, Podcasts, and Music too, not just Radio. Fixed: a crash when playing certain streams with more than 2 audio channels (5.1/7.1 surround sources); Smooth Transitions now actually fades between tracks and stations instead of doing nothing; the mini player no longer shows Radio's Previous/Next controls during a podcast episode. Improved: lower battery use from the playback notification and equalizer, and station/channel refreshes now skip rewriting the cache when nothing changed.
